standard_prerequisites.use: Blow-ups of algebraic spaces along finite type ideals (their definition and universal property, chapter section), schematic closure of subsheaves (cited), the chapter's preceding flattening/extension lemmas, separatedness of the group space for uniqueness of extensions.

core_obligations: Form the closure/graph ideal controlling where the section fails to extend.
Blow up it and check the invertibility hypothesis of the extension lemma.
Produce the extended section matching the prescribed point.

proof_roadmap.step: Ideal/closure construction and blow-up universal property.
Application of the chapter's extension machinery plus separatedness uniqueness.

difficulty_reason: For a flat finite presentation situation where G -> S is a group algebraic space separated and of finite presentation, s : S -> G a section over a dense open, and a point of the special fibre, the lemma produces a blow-up b : S' -> S along a finite type ideal with centre in the complement of the dense open, and a section s' : S' -> G extending the base-changed section on the generic part, matching the given point. The retained proof is written: take the schematic closure of the graph of the section inside G x_S S' candidate (the closure construction is cited), blow up the ideal of the closure's non-flatness locus, invoke the chapter's earlier flattening-via-blowup and valuative extension lemmas whose hypotheses are checked explicitly (separatedness of G kills the ambiguity of the extension by the cited separation argument), and the universal property of the blow-up upgrades the rational map to a morphism on the blow-up because the pulled-back ideal becomes invertible. Retained author proof at lines 9039-9050.

dedup.scope: Extension of a rational section of a separated group space to a full section after a blow-up.
